name: Bradley Scott Schneider
bio: Bradley Scott Schneider is an American businessman and politician who has served as the U.S. representative for Illinois's 10th congressional district since 2017 and also served from 2013 to 2015. The district includes many of Chicago's northern suburbs in the Chicago metropolitan area. Its most populous city is Waukegan, an industrial suburb on Lake Michigan. He is a member of the Democratic Party.
